issuing_orgs: National Institute on Deafness and Other Communication Disorders
synopsis: The objective of this Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) is to support a coordinating center for the NIDCD National Human Ear Resource Network, a collaborative network that serves as a national technological resource for auditory and vestibular researchers to use human inner and middle ear tissues for a range of basic and clinical studies to advance knowledge and treatment of auditory and vestibular disorders.
title: Coordinating Center for National Resource Network for the Study of Human Auditory and Vestibular Disorders (U24 Clinical Trial Not Allowed)
